The file stores only numbers

Every cell of this raster holds one number: the ground height in metres. The colours are not in the file: QGIS gives each cell a colour based on the settings in Layer Properties ▸ Symbology.

Terrain model: Digitaal Vlaanderen, Digitaal Hoogtemodel Vlaanderen II (DTM), resampled to 5 m.
